title: Topic 6
japanese_text:
A：ここの敵が倒せないんだけど…。
B：あー、これはちょっと<u>放置する</u>と、背中を見せて帰っていくからタイミングを見計らって後ろから攻撃すればいいよ。
A：やってみる。あー！ やられた！ <u>不意に</u>振り返るのはずるいって！
B：今のは<u>動揺</u>しなければ倒せてたね。まあ、<u>慣れ</u>だね。そのうち振り返るタイミングも<u>把握</u>できるよ。
english_translation: A: I can't beat the enemy here... B: Ah, if you leave this one alone for a bit, it will turn around and leave, so you can choose the right moment to attack it from behind. A: I'll give it a try. Oh no! It beat me! It's not fair—it turned around unexpectedly! B: If you hadn't gotten agitated, you could have taken it down. Well, you'll get used to it. You'll figure out the timing eventually.
